what: Blind, four versions shown together: SSUI, Cards defaults with strong/muted/caption as before cf42026 (oldtext), the defaults as committed (designed), and designed plus the recorded pass. Judges: Opus and Sonnet subagents of a Claude Code session (no API key was at hand, so not judge.py); two shuffles.

judgments.why: A has the clearest hierarchy and most consistent card system, D and B are near-identical but B's secondary text is too faint, and C's edge-to-edge chart bars and cramped spacing look unrefined.
A has consistent card containers, strong hierarchy and tidy action tiles; C has odd touching bars and cramped chart.
C has the most refined hierarchy with eyebrow section labels, emphasized values and icon tiles, B edges A on more legible secondary text, and D is cramped with a tiny, afterthought log-out button.
C has refined small-caps section labels, clear data emphasis and a restrained logout; D has tiny orphaned buttons and weak structure.

C groups purchase info into polished cards with a struck-through original price, icon tiles and a proper sticky action bar, D and A are near-identical with D's secondary text slightly more legible, and B is flat and cramped.
C groups content into cards with a visible image area and clear hierarchy; A/D are near-identical flat layouts with D having slightly stronger secondary text; B is flat white and plainest.
A is the only one with a complete icon-driven tab bar, stat icons and a clear hero metric, B beats D on more legible secondary text, and C is flat with a tiny Start button and an icon-less tab bar.
A has bold hierarchy, icon tab bar, stat icons and tight rhythm; C has a tiny Start CTA and loose list spacing, and B/D/C lack nav icons.

D fills the empty hero, adds item thumbnails, bolder prices and a floating cart bar for a shipped feel, A and C are near-identical airy card lists with A marginally crisper, and B is flat and cramped.
D has a hero, item thumbnails, bold prices and a floating cart bar that read as a shipped product; A/C are empty-hero card lists and B is flat and cramped.

B has the strongest hierarchy with a bold progress headline, icon tiles and orange streak accents, A edges D on more legible secondary text, and C is flat with merged chart bars and a tiny Add habit button.
B has bold hero stat, icon tiles and orange streak flames giving clear hierarchy; C has a tiny Add habit button and touching chart bars.

B is the most cohesive with a consistent accent palette, stat pills, bold leaderboard values and an icon tab bar, C edges A on more legible secondary text, and D is flat and outlined with weaker polish.
B has icon tab bar, pill stat chips and a strong hero with consistent tokens; A/C/D lack nav icons and D is flat with a low-contrast Continue button.

A has the richest boarding-pass style hierarchy with icon tiles, an inset gate/seat panel and emphasized totals, C edges D through more legible secondary text and times, and B is flat, cramped and faint.

A has the most deliberate hierarchy with icon tiles, tinted detail panels and small-caps labels; B is flatter with weaker contrast; C and D are near-identical, C with slightly stronger secondary text.
C groups content into clear cards with a strong balance hero and polished action row; B edges D on secondary-text contrast; A's cramped, gapless chart bars and smaller type feel least refined.
C groups content into clean cards with a strong hero balance and tidy actions; A has chunky cramped bars and an overly tight header.

A has the clearest label/value hierarchy, a prominent storage figure and tiled device icons; B beats D on secondary-text legibility; C is flat, cramped, with a tiny undersized Log out and Manage button.
A has refined section eyebrows, device icon tiles, a prominent storage figure and a restrained logout, while C is cramped with a tiny orphaned logout button.

C groups purchase info in a card with strikethrough original price, emphasized quantity and icon tiles for features; B's slightly darker secondary text edges A; D is small, cramped and flat with thin-bordered review boxes.
C is the only one with a visible image placeholder, card grouping, icon tiles and a docked CTA bar; B and A are near-identical flat layouts with B slightly better spacing, and D is the most cramped.
C adds stat icons, an iconed tab bar, tighter list rhythm and a strong steps hero; A edges D on secondary-text contrast; B is flat with a tiny Start button and weak, low-contrast metadata.

C has icon-led stats, a real tab bar with icons and tight consistent cards; A and D share a layout with A having more legible secondary text, while B has a small orphaned Start button and outlined cards.

D fills the hero, adds item thumbnails, bold prices and a floating cart bar for the most finished look; B and C are near-identical clean card lists with B's text marginally crisper; A is cramped with small type and tight cards.
D adds a hero, food thumbnails, bold prices and a floating cart bar; B has the roomiest, cleanest cards, C is similar but tighter, and A is cramped with outlined cards.
D adds a bold progress headline, icon tiles, orange streak flames and a carded date strip; A edges C on secondary-text contrast; B is flat with gapless chart bars and an undersized Add habit button.

D has a stronger hero progress figure, icon tiles, orange streak flames and clear weekly strip; A and C are near-identical with A slightly crisper text, while B has an orphaned small Add button and chunky bars.

D is most product-like with stat pills, iconed tab bar and bolder XP values, though its dark Continue button is low-contrast; A beats B on secondary-text legibility; C is flatter and tighter with small type.
D has pill stat chips, a dark hero, consistent blue icon tiles, bold XP values and an icon tab bar; A beats B on secondary text legibility, and C is tight with a low-contrast Continue button.
B has the strongest hierarchy with tinted icon tiles, inset gate/boarding panel and emphasized total; A beats D on time and secondary-text contrast; C is flat, cramped and uses faint tiny timestamps.

B adds icon tiles, tinted detail wells, an eyebrow plan label and a highlighted total for clear hierarchy; A and D are near-identical plain cards with A having stronger secondary text, and C is tight and outlined.
